messages:
incidents-bot: PagerDuty P1 -> inference/gateway. Observed spike in 5xx and request latency across generation endpoints. Paging on-call: @Alex. Incident created: 1718054321. Please acknowledge and triage. :rotating_light:
Alex: Ack — I'm taking IC. On the call in 2 mins. Quick triage: checking autoscaler, GPU health, and gateway logs.
Meera: Jumping in for comms and customer-facing copy. Will draft initial statuspage + notify CS once we have scope.
Jason: Running `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide` now, seeing multiple restart loops on modelpool-2. Also seeing autoscaler backoff. Pushing logs to the incident channel.
Alex: Assigning roles — IC: Alex; Tech lead: Jason; Comms lead: Meera; Scribe: Emily. If we need an escalation / exec notif I'll ping Liam.
Emily: Noted. I'll capture timestamps and any config changes.
Meera: Draft initial statuspage update (please review):
```
We are investigating increased errors and latency impacting the Redwood Generation API in the us-west-2 region. Some requests are returning 5xx or timing out.
Impact: A subset of customers and routes may experience degraded response times and intermittent failures. Embeddings and unrelated regions are not impacted at this time.
Mitigation: Engineering is actively triaging, scaling affected pools, and routing traffic to standby capacity.
Next update: in ~30 minutes or sooner when we have root cause or mitigation progress.
```
Jason: Small edit suggested — call out that this is impacting "generation (text) endpoints only" and that we're failing fast on a subset of model shards.
Meera: Updated draft with that language. New draft below — please job-audit if okay: 
```
We are investigating increased errors and latency impacting the Redwood Generation (text) API in us-west-2. A subset of model shards is returning 5xx errors or timing out, causing degraded responses for some customers and routes.
Impact: Generation/text requests routed to affected shards may see higher latency or errors; embeddings and non-affected regions are operating normally.
Mitigation: Engineering is scaling pools, cordoning problematic nodes, and routing traffic to standby pools. We will provide updates every 30 minutes or sooner.
```
Alex: Good. Include a short customer-facing ETA: "investigating, no ETA yet; updates every 30m." Approve to post initial.
Meera: Planning to publish initial statuspage update now. Quick checklist before publish: (1) confirm no PII in logs, (2) set update cadence to 30m, (3) link to published status URL and incident number in CS ticket.
Jason: Technical update: autoscaler failed to provision new instances due to a quota error on the project — creating new nodes is rate-limited. I'm temporarily scaling via spare node pool and rolling affected deploys to standby; working with infra to lift the quota.
Alex: Thanks. That helps the comms wording — add "temporary capacity/quotas" note in next update.
Meera: Periodic update (30m):
```
Update (30m): Engineering confirmed that node provisioning was rate-limited by a quota. We have started failover to standby pools and are gradually restoring capacity. Some customers may still see intermittent errors; overall error rates trending down. We will continue to monitor and post another update in 30 minutes or when we have resolution.
```
Emily: Minor suggestion — add a "customer impact" bullet with guidance: "If you see failures, retry; we are not rolling back model versions."
Meera: Added. New periodic update ready. Alex ok to publish cadence?
Alex: Approve. Publish initial and schedule periodic updates every 30m. Meera -> publish now. Emily -> create CS ticket + outbound for high-touch customers (Liam to approve message).
incidents-bot: Statuspage initial update published: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/IR-1718054321 (automated).
Meera: Published initial update. Posting to #customer-notifications: draft message for CS review:
"We're seeing intermittent generation errors in us-west-2. Our engineers are actively failing over traffic to standby capacity and working with cloud infra to resolve a quota-related provisioning failure. We'll update you every 30 minutes."
Liam: Reviewed the CS message — ok to send to top 10 enterprise customers. Add the incident link and recommended retry guidance. :thumbsup:
Jason: Technical note: rolling restart of modelpool-2 is at 60% — error spike reduced by ~40% since mitigation started. Metrics: 5xx rate down from 7% -> 4.2% over last 12 minutes.
Alex: Good progress. Keep the cadence. If we hit <1% 5xx sustained for 15m we can consider resolved.
Meera: Draft resolved notice (if we reach stable):
```
Resolved: The Generation API in us-west-2 experienced degraded performance and intermittent 5xx errors due to a cloud quota preventing node provisioning. Engineering failed over traffic to standby capacity and scaled pools, after which error rates normalized. All services are operational; customers should see normal behavior. If you continue to experience issues, please contact support with your request ID.
```
Emily: I'll hold on sending resolved until we have 15m stable and Jason confirms. Also creating the incident channel summary and attaching logs.
Jason: We reached 15 continuous minutes with 5xx <1% at 1718059000. Rolling restarts finished 100% at 1718058800. Quota request approved by infra; new nodes are provisioning.
Alex: Confirmed. Emily, please publish the resolved update and close the incident once done. Meera, go ahead and post the resolved statuspage text.
incidents-bot: Publishing resolved update to statuspage...
incidents-bot: Resolved update posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/IR-1718054321/resolved (automated).
Meera: Resolved message posted. Sending CS outbound to enterprise contacts now.
Liam: Thanks team. I'll start the postmortem draft and link to this thread. Reminder: include timeline, root cause (quota + autoscaler fallback logic), and remediation (improve quota monitoring + fallback pool pre-provision).
Alex: Great job. Post-incident actions: owner Jason (root cause + infra follow-up), Meera (email + statuspage post mortem blurb), Emily (create incident summary + ticket links), Liam (internal exec summary).
Emily: Capturing action items now. Closing thread after postmortem doc link is posted. :white_check_mark:
